text:
carmen: heads-up team — change window tonight 23:00 UTC for docstore index migration + model pin. please shout if you need an exemption.

deploy-bot: change window 'slice-maint' scheduled 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z -> 2026-03-23T00:30:00Z. owners: @carmen, @noah.

noah: ack. rollout plan: canary 3 steps (5%/30%/100%), 8m holds, manual proceed. abort conditions: 5xx > 0.8% or p95 +150ms.

tess: confirm rollback runbook location? want the exact commands in-thread.

ravi: rollback is `./ops/rollback.sh --service docstore --tag v3.1.9` from ops-runner. emergency unpin via `deploy-bot unpin service/docstore`.

carmen: I'll apply pin before warmup. deploy-bot, please pin v3.2.2 now (pending confirm).

deploy-bot: pin request: `pin service/docstore v3.2.2` by carmen. Reply with `confirm` to apply.

carmen: confirm

deploy-bot: pin applied. Audit: carmen @ 3187777777.

ops-bot: preflight: smoke smoke-ok, disk pressure on one eu-west node (will be cordoned and drained during warmup).

noah: warmup plan includes cordon+restart of that node at canary start. note added to release doc.

tess: SDK teams want a short maintenance banner. can we send T-20m?

carmen: make it T-10m and keep message short. ops prefers minimal lead.

ravi: adding quick rollback snippet to #runbooks: `ssh ops-runner && ./ops/rollback.sh --service docstore --tag v3.1.9 && deploy-bot unpin service/docstore`.

tess: post-launch checklist (first 30m): DB index health, KV cache hitrate, model-routing log sample, p50/p95 latency, error budget. I'll monitor traces.

noah: also watch batching metrics and token serving latencies for the model variant. accidental quantization swap ceremony last time, so double-check routing table.

carmen: final rules: no docstore merges after T-45m; public release notes at T+30m if all good; emergency unpin owner = ravi.

noah: will post T-10m banner and mute non-essential alerts.

tess: ack.

ravi: ack and standing by.

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled in 20 minutes: 'slice-maint' starts in 20m.

carmen: thanks everyone. keep chatter here during window; escalate cross-org to #release-war-room if we need to go public. :thumbsup:
